notes: Synthetic scenes, not real game accuracy. Training and evaluation PNGs are disjoint; held-out text and style are not passed to the learner.

Training observes identical input per candidate in separate serialized runs. Online exploration on another frame is not strict A/B.
Resource snapshots include host and currently resident workers; retired process CPU time is not available, so no aggregate CPU utilization is invented.
No background training or simultaneous alternative pools.
